description: Cylindrical shell (Ri 100, Ro 120, H 300 mm) with a radial nozzle (ri 25, ro 35 mm, open end at X = 220 mm), base fixed, 2 MPa internal pressure. Linear tetrahedra, linear elastic steel.

title_block.title: Nozzle in cylindrical shell, internal pressure
title_block.author: codeaster-en

checks.quantity: Sum of X reactions at the base [N]
checks.basis: Equilibrium: reaction sum = -(applied pressure resultant), so +X (REAC_NODA is the support reaction; sign confirmed by the first run, task 4.2). With the nozzle end open, the resultant is P times the projected area of the bore opening along -X (P pi ri^2 = 3927 N for a true circle); the reference is the exact resultant on the faceted mesh, computed by tests/fixtures/hand_values.py (applied FX = -3891.64 N, FY = FZ = 0).
